וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל־נָא כֹּחַ אֲדֹנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לֵאמֹר:
זְכֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה:
חזן

יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְמָא דִּבְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.

יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל־בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ:

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה:
זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים. וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים. לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם:

אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה:
מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים. זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים.
וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים:
אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל־יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶלָה:

וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל־מַה־שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ וְיִירָאוּךָ כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶיךָ עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִימִינֶךָ וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל־מַה־שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ:

וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶךָ וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶךָ וּצְמִיחַת קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּךָ וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן־יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶךָ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ:

וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ־פִּיהָ. וְכָל־הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כֶּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן־הָאָרֶץ:

וְתִמְלֹךְ אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדֶּךָ עַל כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ. כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ: יִמְלֹךְ יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ:

קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶךָ וְאֵין אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ. כַּכָּתוּב וַיִּגְבַּהּ יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדָּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמֶּלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ:

אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים. אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ. וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת. וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ:
וַתִּתֶּן־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה אֶת־יוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְאֶת יוֹם) הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה. יוֹם (זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָה (בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם:

וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵינוּ גָּלִינוּ מֵאַרְצֵנוּ וְנִתְרַחַקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵנוּ וְאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶךָ בַּבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶׁךָ: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים וְתִבְנֵהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד־מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה וְהוֹפַע וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָּל חָי וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם וּנְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָרֶץ וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם: וְאֶת מוּסְפֵי יוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְיוֹם) הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנֶךָ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְתָּ עָלֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶךָ כָּאָמוּר:
(אם שבת:)
וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ:
עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ:
וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם:
וַעֲשִׂיתֶם עֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיְיָ פַּר בֶּן־
בָּקָר אֶחָד אַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם:

וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כַּמְדֻבָּר שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָיִל וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ וְיַיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ וּשְׁנֵי־שְׂעִירִים לְכַפֵּר. וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַחֹדֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָהּ. וְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ. וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיְיָ:
בק״ק כפידק ובכמה לומרים.
וּשְׂעִיר לְכַפֵּר מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַחֹדֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָהּ וּשְׂעִיר לְחַטָּאת וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם:
(אם שבת:)

יִשְׂמְחוּ בְמַלְכוּתְךָ שׁוֹמְרֵי שַׁבָּת וְקוֹרְאֵי עֹנֶג עַם מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁבִיעִי. כֻּלָּם יִשְׂבְּעוּ וְיִתְעַנְּגוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וּבַשְּׁבִיעִי רָצִיתָ בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ חֶמְדַּת יָמִים אוֹתוֹ קָרָאתָ זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:

עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל־הֲמוֹנָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ כוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים: הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד. אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ. כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ. וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל־לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד:

עַל־כֵּן נְקַוֶּה־לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן. לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי וְכָל־בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶךָ. לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶיךָ כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ. יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ

תִּכְרַע כָּל־בֶּרֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל־לָשׁוֹן: לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּלוּ: וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּנוּ. וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם אֶת־עֹל מַלְכוּתֶךָ. וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:
יְהֹוָה יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וְנֶאֱמַר לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ:
וְנֶאֱמַר וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר כִּי לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה וּמוֹשֵׁל בַּגּוֹיִם:
וְנֶאֱמַר יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט:
וְנֶאֱמַר שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד:
מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְיָ גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה:
שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד:
מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה:
וְעַל יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגֹאֲלוֹ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי רִאשׁוֹן וַאֲנִי אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדַי אֵין אֱלֹהִים:
וְנֶאֱמַר וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה:
וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. מְלֹךְ עַל כָּל־הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדֶךָ וְהִנָּשֵׂא עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ בִּיקָרֶךָ וְהוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּךָ עַל כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶךָ. וְיֵדַע כָּל־פָּעוּל כִּי אַתָּה פְעַלְתּוֹ וְיָבִין כָּל־יְצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ וְיֹאמַר

כָּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְאַפּוֹ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶלֶךְ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה: (אם שבת. אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ) קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ. (אם שבת. וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ וְיָנוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ.) וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת וּדְבָרְךָ (מַלְכֵּנוּ) אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ) יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן:

אַתָּה זוֹכֵר מַעֲשֵׂה עוֹלָם וּפוֹקֵד כָּל־יְצוּרֵי קֶדֶם. לְפָנֶיךָ נִגְלוּ כָּל־תַּעֲלוּמוֹת וַהֲמוֹן נִסְתָּרוֹת שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית. כִּי אֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ. וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ: אַתָּה זוֹכֵר אֶת־כָּל־הַמִּפְעָל. וְגַם כָּל־הַיְצוּר לֹא נִכְחַד מִמֶּךָ. הַכֹּל גָּלוּי וְיָדוּעַ לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ. צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט עַד סוֹף כָּל־הַדּוֹרוֹת. כִּי תָבִיא חֹק זִכָּרוֹן לְהִפָּקֵד כָּל־רוּחַ וָנָפֶשׁ. לְהִזָּכֵר מַעֲשִׂים רַבִּים וַהֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת לְאֵין תַּכְלִית. מֵרֵאשִׁית כָּזֹאת הוֹדַעְתָּ. וּמִלְּפָנִים אוֹתָהּ גִּלִּיתָ. זֶה הַיּוֹם תְּחִלַּת מַעֲשֶׂיךָ זִכָּרוֹן לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן. כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב: וְעַל הַמְּדִינוֹת בּוֹ יֵאָמֵר אֵיזוֹ לַחֶרֶב. וְאֵיזוֹ לַשָּׁלוֹם. אֵיזוֹ לָרָעָב. וְאֵיזוֹ לַשָּׂבַע. וּבְרִיּוֹת בּוֹ יִפָּקֵדוּ. לְהַזְכִּירָם לְחַיִּים וְלַמָּוֶת: מִי לֹא נִפְקַד כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. כִּי זֵכֶר כָּל הַיְצוּר לְפָנֶיךָ בָּא. מַעֲשֵׂה אִישׁ וּפְקֻדָּתוֹ. וַעֲלִילוֹת מִצְעֲדֵי גָבֶר. מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם וְתַחְבּוּלוֹתָיו וְיִצְרֵי מַעַלְלֵי אִישׁ: אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁכָּחֶךָ. וּבֶן־אָדָם יִתְאַמֶּץ־בָּךְ. כִּי דוֹרְשֶׁיךָ

לְעוֹלָם לֹא יִכָּשֵׁלוּ. וְלֹא יִכָּלְמוּ לָנֶצַח כָּל־הַחוֹסִים בָּךְ: כִּי זֵכֶר כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים לְפָנֶיךָ בָּא וְאַתָּה דוֹרֵשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה כֻלָּם: וְגַם אֶת־נֹחַ בְּאַהֲבָה זָכַרְתָּ. וַתִּפְקְדֵהוּ בִּדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים בַּהֲבִיאֲךָ אֶת־מֵי הַמַּבּוּל לְשַׁחֵת כָּל־בָּשָׂר מִפְּנֵי רֹעַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם. עַל־כֵּן זִכְרוֹנוֹ בָּא לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְהַרְבּוֹת זַרְעוֹ כְּעַפְרוֹת תֵּבֵל. וְצֶאֱצָאָיו כְּחוֹל הַיָּם: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ
וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹחַ וְאֵת כָּל־הַחַיָּה וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ הַמָּיִם:
וְנֶאֱמַר וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֶת־יַעֲקֹב:
וְנֶאֱמַר וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר וְהָאָרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר:
וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ:
וְנֶאֱמַר טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:
וְנֶאֱמַר וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חֲסָדָיו:

וְעַל־יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר הָלֹךְ וְקָרָאתָ בְאָזְנֵי יְרוּשָׁלַיִם לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ זָכַרְתִּי לָךְ חֶסֶד נְעוּרַיִךְ אַהֲבַת כְּלוּלֹתָיִךְ לֶכְתֵּךְ אַחֲרַי בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא זְרוּעָה:
וְנֶאֱמַר וְזָכַרְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אוֹתָךְ בִּימֵי נְעוּרָיִךְ וַהֲקִימוֹתִי לָךְ בְּרִית עוֹלָם:
וְנֶאֱמַר הֲבֵן יַקִּיר לִי אֶפְרַיִם אִם יֶלֶד שַׁעֲשֻׁעִים כִּי־מִדֵּי דַבְּרִי בּוֹ זָכֹר אֶזְכְּרֶנּוּ עוֹד עַל־כֵּן הָמוּ מֵעַי לוֹ רַחֵם אֲרַחֲמֶנּוּ נְאֻם־יְיָ:
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ זָכְרֵנוּ בְּזִכָּרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶיךָ וּפָקְדֵנוּ בִּפְקֻדַּת יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים מִשְּׁמֵי שְׁמֵי קֶדֶם וּזְכָר־לָנוּ יְיָ

אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת־הַבְּרִית וְאֶת־הַחֶסֶד וְאֶת־הַשְּׁבוּעָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה וְתֵרָאֶה לְפָנֶיךָ עֲקֵדָה שֶׁעָקַד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ אֶת־יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ עַל גַּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְכָבַשׁ רַחֲמָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם כֵּן יִכְבְּשׁוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ אֶת־כַּעַסְךָ מֵעָלֵינוּ וּבְטוּבְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יָשׁוּב חֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ מֵעַמְּךָ וּמֵעִירְךָ וּמִנַּחֲלָתֶךָ. וְקַיֶּם־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶךָ לֵאמֹר:
וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי־אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְיָ:

כִּי זוֹכֵר כָּל־הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת אַתָּה הוּא מֵעוֹלָם וְאֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ. וַעֲקֵדַת יִצְחָק לְזַרְעוֹ (שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב) הַיּוֹם בְּרַחֲמִים תִּזְכֹּר. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ זוֹכֵר הַבְּרִית:

אַתָּה נִגְלֵיתָ בַּעֲנַן כְּבוֹדֶךָ עַל עַם קָדְשְׁךָ לְדַבֵּר עִמָּם מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּם קוֹלֶךָ וְנִגְלֵיתָ עֲלֵיהֶם בְּעַרְפְּלֵּי־טֹהַר. גַּם (כָּל) הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ חָל מִפָּנֶיךָ וּבְרִיּוֹת בְּרֵאשִׁית חָרְדוּ מִמֶּךָ בְּהִגָּלוֹתְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ עַל־הַר־סִינַי לְלַמֵּד לְעַמְּךָ תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת. וַתַּשְׁמִיעֵם אֶת־הוֹד קוֹלֶךָ וְדִבְּרוֹת קָדְשְׁךָ מִלַּהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ. בְּקוֹלוֹת וּבְרָקִים עֲלֵיהֶם נִגְלֵיתָ וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר עֲלֵיהֶם הוֹפָעְתָּ: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ.
וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיוֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל־הָהָר וְקֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד וַיֶּחֱרַד כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה:
וְנֶאֱמַר וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶנּוּ בְקוֹל:
וְנֶאֱמַר וְכָל־הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת־הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר
וְאֶת־הָהָר עָשֵׁן וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻעוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מֵרָחֹק:
וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְיָ בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר:
וְנֶאֱמַר בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְיָ:
וְנֶאֱמַר תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֶּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ:
כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב:
וְנֶאֱמַר הַלְלוּיָהּ הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ:
הַלְלוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו הַלְלוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ:
הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר הַלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר:
הַלְלוּהוּ בְתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעֻגָב:
הַלְלוּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָׁמַע הַלְלוּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵי תְרוּעָה:
כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַלְלוּיָהּ:
וְעַל־יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְשֹׁכְנֵי אָרֶץ כִּנְשֹׂא־נֵס הָרִים תִּרְאוּ וְכִתְקֹעַ שׁוֹפָר תִּשְׁמָעוּ:
וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל וּבָאוּ הָאֹבְדִים בְּאֶרֶץ אַשּׁוּר וְהַנִּדָּחִים בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיְיָ בְּהַר הַקֹּדֶשׁ בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם:
וְנֶאֱמַר וַיְיָ עֲלֵיהֶם יֵרָאֶה וְיָצָא כַבָּרָק חִצּוֹ וַאֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה בַּשּׁוֹפָר יִתְקָע וְהָלַךְ בְּסַעֲרוֹת תֵּימָן:
יְיָ צְבָאוֹת יָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם. כֵּן תָּגֵן עַל־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵרוּתֵנוּ וְשָׂא נֵס לְקַבֵּץ גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם וּנְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָרֶץ וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ כִמְצֻוֶּה (כ״י כְּמִצְוָה) עָלֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶךָ כָּאָמוּר:
וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶם וּבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם וּבְרָאשֵׁי חָדְשֵׁכֶם וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּחֲצֹצְרֹת עַל עֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְעַל זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם
לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲנִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם:
כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר וּמַאֲזִין תְּרוּעָה וְאֵין דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ שׁוֹמֵעַ קוֹל תְּרוּעַת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרַחֲמִים:

רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם. וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:

מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ־לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּנוּ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם. הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא־כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא־תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ:
וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל־בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ:
וְכָל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:

שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ:
בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנַחְנוּ וְכָל־עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ עֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם:

אֱלֹהַי נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה. וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם וְנַפְשִׁי כֶעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה: פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי. וְכָל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחְשְׁבֹתָם. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ. הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:

יְהִי רָצוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ: וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת: וְעָרְבָה לַיְיָ מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָם כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת:
חֲזָרַת הַתְּפִלָּה לִשְׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר.
פותחים חלון.

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה:

מִסּוֹד חֲכָמִים וּנְבוֹנִים. וּמִלֶּמֶד דַּעַת מְבִינִים. אֶפְתְּחָה פִי בִּתְפִלָּה וּבְתַחֲנוּנִים. לְחַלּוֹת וּלְחַנֵּן פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים וַאֲדוֹנֵי הָאֲדוֹנִים (כ״י פְּנֵי מַטֵּה מָלֵא רַחֲמִים):
סוגרים חלון.
מיוסד ע״ס א״ב.
ק׳

אֶפֶד מֵאָז לְשָׁפְטִי הַיּוֹם. בְּחוּן מַעֲשֵׂה כָל יוֹם. גִּשַּׁת יְקוּמִים פְּנֵי אָיוֹם. דִּינָם בּוֹ לְפַלֵּס לְפִדְיוֹם: הָרִאשׁוֹן אָדָם בּוֹ נוּצַר. וְצֻוָּה חֹק וְלֹא נָצַר. זֶה מֵלִיץ כְּהִרְחִיב בַּצַּר. חֻקּוֹ לְמִשְׁפָּט וּלְדוֹרוֹת מִנְצָר: טִמְעַת חוֹצֵב גְּבָעוֹת וְצוּרִים. יַלְדֵי בוֹ מֵרֹאשׁ צוּרִים. כְּיוֹשְׁבֵי נְטָעִים הֵמָּה הַיּוֹצְרִים. לְלַמֵּד בּוֹ צֶדֶק לָעֲצוּרִים: מִיּוֹם שָׂמוֹ כְּשֵׁם אֵיתָנִים. נָם לְחַנְּנָם עֶלְיוֹנִים וְתַחְתּוֹנִים. סְפָרִים נִפְתָּחִים וּמַעֲשִׂים מִתְּנַנִּים. עוֹבְרִים לְפָנֶיךָ וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן נוֹתְנִים: פָּקִיד הָכֵן לְתַקֵּן מְעוּדֶיךָ. צֹאן לְהַעֲבִיר כְּשֵׁבֶט עֲדָיֶךָ:
חי
קֶרֶן כְּמַעֲשִׂים (אם שבת קֶרֶן נִזְכָּרִים) הַיּוֹם עָדֶיךָ. רַחוּם זְכוֹר שְׁבוּעַת עֲבָדֶיךָ:
קהל
נַעֲלֶה שׁוֹפָר עִם תַּחֲנוּן. שַׁדַּי לְפָרוֹתָךְ טַעַם בְּחִנּוּן.
חזן
תַּעֲזִיב לְעוֹרֵר (כ״י לְגוֹדֵד) בְּבָרַק רִשְׁנוּן. תַּחֲזִיק מָגֵן לְגוֹנְנִי בְּגִנּוּן:
פותחים החלון.
זָכְרֵנוּ לְחַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים. וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים. לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם:
Musaph for the New Year
The Reader says half Kaddish.
And now may the power of the Lord appear great, as Thou hast said.
Remember Thy mercies, O Lord, and and Thy kindnesses, for they exist since eternity.

Exalted and sanctified be His Great Name in the world which He has created according to His will. May His Kingdom be established in your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of the whole House of Israel, speedily and in a short time, and say: Amen!
May His Grant Name be praised to eternity and the eternity of eternities!

Blessed and praised and glorified and elevated and exalted and adorned and raised on high and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He; high, yea high, above all blessing and song, praise and comfort that have ever been spoken in the world, and say Amen!
Lord, open my lips and my mouth will tell of Thy fame.

Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, the great, mighty and awe-inspiring God, God the Most High, who performs acts of kindness and owns everything and remembers the good deeds of the fathers and will bring a redeemer for their children’s children for His Name’s sake in love.

Remember us for life, O King who delights in life, and inscribe us in the book of life for Thy sake, O living God. O King, helper and saviour and shield, blessed art Thou, O Lord, the shield of Abraham.

Thou art for ever mighty, O Lord the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save. Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling and healing the sick and releasing captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King, who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth.
Who is like Thee, Father of compassion, who remembers His creatures for life in compassion.
And Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who revives the dead.
Thou art holy and Thy Name is holy and holy ones praise Thee every day. Selah!

And therefore put the fear of Thee, O Lord our God, upon all Thy works and awe of Thee upon all that Thou hast created, so that all works may fear Thee and all the created bow down before Thee and all of them may be made into one group for the performance of Thy will with a complete heart, since we know, O Lord our God, that dominion lies before Thee, that strength is in Thy hand and might in Thy right hand and that Thy Name inspires with awe all that Thou has created.

And therefore grant honour, O Lord, to Thy people, fame to those who fear Thee and praise to those who seek Thee and confidence to those who wait for Thee, joy to Thy land happiness to Thy city and a rise of fortune to David Thy servant and an array of light to the son of Jesse Thine anointed speedily and in our days.

And thus may the righteous see and rejoice and the upright exult and the pious revel with joy. Vice shall close its mouth and all evil entirely disappear like smoke when Thou removest the dominion of arrogance from the earth.

And Thou, O Lord, shalt reign alone over all Thy works on Mount Zion, Thy glorious dwelling, and in Jerusalem, Thy Holy City, as it is written in Thy holy word, the Lord shall reign for ever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah!

Holy art Thou and awe-inspiring is Thy Name and there is no God beside Thee, as it is written, exalted is the Lord of Hosts through judgment and the Holy God is sanctified through righteousness. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the Holy King.

Thou hast chosen us from all peoples, loved us and found delight in us and exalted us above all tongues and sanctified us through Thy commandments, and brought us near, O our King, to Thy service and proclaimed Thy great and holy Name unto us.

Thou hast given us, O Lord our God, in love this day (of the Sabbath and this day) of remembrance, a day (of remembrance) of Teruah (in love) for a sacred convocation, a reminder of the exodus from Egypt.

Because of our sins we were exiled from our land and removed from our soil and we are unable to fulfil our duties in the House of Thy choice upon which Thy Name has been called, because of the hand that was stretched out against Thy sanctuary. May it be pleasing to Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, O compassionate King, that Thou mayest again, in Thine abundant mercies, have compassion on us and on Thy sanctuary and rebuild it speedily and add to its glory. Our Father, our King, speedily reveal the glory of Thy Kingdom to us and appear and be exalted over us before the eyes of all the living. Bring near our dispersed ones from among the nations and collect our scattered ones from the corners of the earth and bring us to Zion, Thy city, in mirth, and to Jerusalem the House of Thy sanctuary, in eternal joy. There we will perform before Thee our sacrificial obligations, the regular offerings according to their order and the additional offerings according to their rule. And the additional offerings of this day of memorial we will prepare and offer up before Thee in love according to the commandment of Thy will as Thou hast written for us in Thy Torah through Moses Thy servant from Thy glorious mouth, saying:
(On the Sabbath)
On the Sabbath day two flawless lambs in their first year and two tenths of flour mixed with oil as a meal offering, and its drink offering.
The Sabbath whole-offering on its Sabbath day in addition to the regular whole-offering and its drink offering.
In the seventh month on the first day of the month you shall have a sacred assembly. You may not do any form of work, a day of Teruah shall it be for you.
You shall prepare a whole-offering of sweet savour to the Lord, one young
bullock, one ram, seven flawless lambs in their first year.

Their meal-offering and their drink offering shall be as has been said, three tenths for the bullock, two tenths for the ram and one tenth for each lamb, wine according to its drink-offering and two he-goats in order to atone and the two regular offerings according to their rule. Besides the whole-offering of the new moon and its meal-offering and the regular whole-offering and its meal-offering and the drink offerings according to their rule for a sweet savour, a fire offering to the Lord.
(On the Sabbath)

Let those who observe the Sabbath and call it a delight, the people who sanctify the seventh day, rejoice in Thy kingdom. Let them all be satisfied and find delight out of Thine abundance. Thou hast favoured the seventh day and sanctified it, the most precious of days hast Thou called it, a reminder of the work of creation.

It is right for us to praise the Master of everything, and ascribe greatness to the Creator of the beginning, that He has not made us like the nations of the lands and has not placed us like the families of the earth, that He has not made our portion like theirs nor our destiny like that of all their multitude. We kneel, bow down and give thanks before the Supreme King of kings, the Holy One blessed be He, who has extended the heavens and founded the earth and His glorious dwelling is in Heaven above and His mighty presence in the loftiest heights. He is our God, there is no other. In truth He is our King, there is none besides Him. As it is written in His Torah: ‘And you shall know this day and repeat it in your heart that the Lord is God in the heavens above and that on earth below there is no other.’

Therefore we hope for Thee, O Lord our God, that we may soon behold the glory of Thy strength, that abominations may disappear from the earth and idols be entirely cut down, so that the world may be remedied through the Kingdom of the Almighty and all children of man may call upon Thy Name, and all the wicked of the earth may turn to Thee. All inhabitants of the world will perceive and know that to

Thee every knee should bow and every tongue swear. Before Thee, O Lord our God, will they kneel and fall and to the glory of Thy Name will they grant honour and they will all accept the yoke of Thy Kingdom. And Thou shalt soon reign over them for ever and ever. For Thine is the Kingdom and for all eternity shalt Thou reign in glory
as it is written in Thy Torah:
‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever’.
And it was said: ‘And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel, the Lord His God is with him and the royal Teruah within him.’
And it was said: ‘And He became King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel’.
And in Thy holy words it is written saying: ‘For dominion is the Lord’s and He is ruler over nations’.
And it was said: ‘The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter.’
And it was said: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in war.
Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’.

And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘Thus says the Lord, the King of Israel and its redeemer, the Lord of Hosts: I am the first and I am the last and apart from Me there is no God’.
And it was said: ‘Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s’.
And it was said: ‘And the Lord shall be King over all the earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One’.
And in Thy Torah it is written saying: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One’.

Our God and God of our fathers, reign over the whole world in Thy glory and rise above the whole earth in Thy grandeur. Shine forth in the exalted beauty of Thy might upon all the inhabitants of the territory of Thine earth so that every creature may recognize that Thou hast created it

and that every form may understand that Thou hast formed it and all with breath in the nostrils may say: The Lord, the God of Israel, is King and His Kingdom rules over all. (Our God and God of our fathers, take pleasure in our rest.) Sanctify us through Thy commandments and grant our portion in Thy Torah, satisfy us with Thy goodness and gladden us with Thy help (and grant us, O Lord our God, in love and favour, Thy holy Sabbath as a portion so that Israel, who sanctifies Thy Name, may rest on it) and purify our heart to serve Thee in truth for Thou, O Lord, art truth and Thy word is truth and endures for ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord King over the whole earth, who sanctifies (the Sabbath and) Israel and the Day of Remembrance.

Thou rememberest the work of the world and Thou art aware of all creatures of antiquity. Before Thee all secrets are revealed and the multitude of hidden things from the beginning of time. There is no forgetfulness before Thy glorious throne and there is nought concealed before Thine eyes. Thou rememberest every deed and not even one creature is hidden from Thee. Everything is exposed and known before Thee, O Lord our God, watching and looking to the end of all generations. For Thou dost bring a fixed time for remembrance, when every spirit and soul will be considered and many deeds and an infinite mass of creatures will be remembered. From the beginning hast Thou made this known and long ago revealed it. This is the day of the beginning of Thy works, a memorial of the first day, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob. And regarding territories, it is decided on it which shall be for the sword and which for peace, which for famine and which for plenty. And the creatures will be considered on it to be mentioned either for life or death. Who is not considered on this day? Indeed the memory of every created thing comes before Thee, man’s work and his task, the actions of man’s footsteps, man’s thought and his devises, and the motives of man’s deeds. Fortunate the man who does not forget Thee and the

son of man who clings to Thee, for those that seek Thee will never stumble nor will those that take refuge with Thee ever be disgraced. For the remembrance of all actions comes before Thee and Thou dost examine all of them. Noah also didst Thou remember in love and consider for the sake of salvation and compassion when Thou didst bring the waters of the flood to destroy all flesh because of the wickedness of their actions. Therefore his memory came before Thee, O Lord our God, to increase his descendants like the dust of the earth and his offspring like the sand of the sea, as it is written in Thy Torah:
‘God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark, and God caused a wind to pass over the earth and the waters subsided’.
And it was said: ‘God heard their cry, then God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob’.
And it was said: ‘I will remember my covenant with Jacob, as well as my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham will I also remember, and the land will I remember.’
And in Thy holy words it is written: ‘A memorial has He made for His wonders, gracious and compassionate is the Lord’.
And it was said: ‘He gave food to those that fear Him, He will remember His covenant for ever’.
And it was said: ‘He remembered unto them His covenant and He reversed the decree according to the abundance of His kindness’.

And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: I remember unto you the grace of your youth, the love of your betrothal, when you followed me in the wilderness in land unsown’.
And it was said: ‘I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth and establish with you an everlasting covenant’.

And it was said: ‘Is Ephraim a dear son to me, or a delightful child that whenever I speak of him, I still remember him? Accordingly, my love for him is aroused, I shall surely have compassion on him, says the Lord’.
Our God and God of our fathers, remember us with a good remembrance before Thee and consider us with salvation and compassion from the ancient heavens and remember

on our behalf, O Lord our God, the covenant and the grace and the oath which Thou hast sworn to our father Abraham on Mount Moriah and let there appear before Thee the scene when Abraham our father bound his son Isaac on the altar and subdued his compassion in order to do Thy will with a whole heart. Thus let Thy compassion subdue Thy wrath from upon us and in Thy great goodness let the fury of Thine anger turn back from Thy people, Thy city and Thine inheritance. Fulfil for us, O Lord our God, the word that Thou hast promised us in Thy Torah, through Thy servant Moses through the mouth of Thy glory, as it is said:
‘And I shall remember on their behalf the covenant with their predecessors whom I brought out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations in order to become their God, I am the Lord’.

For Thou dost remember from eternity all that has been forgotten and there is no forgetfulness before Thy glorious throne and the binding of Isaac wilt Thou remember on behalf of his seed in compassion this day. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who remembers the covenant.

Thou hast revealed Thyself in the cloud of Thy glory to Thy holy people in order to speak with them, from heaven hast Thou made Thy voice heard to them and in clouds of purity hast Thou revealed Thyself to them. The whole world trembled before Thee and the creatures of the creation were in awe of Thee when Thou didst reveal Thyself, O our King, on Mount Sinai in order to teach Thy people Torah and commandment. Thou didst make them hear the majesty of Thy voice and Thy holy words out of fiery flames. With thunder and lightning didst Thou reveal Thyself to them and with the sound of the Shofar didst Thou appear to them as it is written in Thy Torah:

‘And it happened on the third day during the morning that there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud lay over the mountain and there was a very powerful sound of the Shofar and all the people in the camp were afraid’.
And it was said: ‘And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud’.
And it was said: ‘And all the people were seeing the thunder and the lightning and the
sound of the Shofar and the mountain in smoke, the people saw and trembled and stood at a distance’.
And in Thy holy words it is written saying: ‘God has arisen with Teruah, the Lord with a Shofar sound’.
And it was said: ‘with trumpets and the Shofar sound cry out before the King, the Lord’.
And it was said: ‘Blow the Shofar on the new moon, when the moon is covered, on the day of our festival,
for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob’.
And it was said: ‘Halleluyah, praise God for His holiness, praise Him for the strong firmament.
Praise Him for His mighty deeds, praise Him for the abundance of His greatness.
Praise Him with the Shofar blast, praise Him with zither and the harp.
Praise Him with timbrel and dance, praise Him with string instruments and flutes,
praise Him with the clash of cymbals, praise Him with the ring of cymbals.
Let all with breath praise the Lord, Halleluyah.

And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘all inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth, when the banner is raised on the mountain shall you see and when the Shofar is blown shall you hear’.

And it was said: ‘And on that day the great Shofar will be blown and the wanderers in the land of Assyria and the banished in the land of Egypt shall come and prostrate themselves to the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem’.
And it was said: ‘And the Lord will appear to them and His arrow shall go forth like lightning and the Lord God will blow the Shofar and He will walk in the whirlwinds of the south.
The Lord of Hosts will protect them’. So mayest Thou protect Thy people Israel with Thy peace.

Our God and God of our fathers, blow the great Shofar for our freedom and raise a banner for the gathering of our exiles and bring near our dispersed ones from the corners of the earth and bring us to Zion Thy city in mirth and to Jerusalem Thy sanctuary in eternal joy and there we will perform before Thee our sacrificial obligations according to the commandment given to us in Thy Torah through Thy servant Moses from the mouth of Thy glory as it is said:
‘and on the day of your rejoicing and on your festivals and on your new moons, you shall blow trumpets over your whole-offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings
and they shall be a reminder on your behalf before your God, I am the Lord your God’.
For Thou dost hear the sound of the Shofar and listen to Teruah and there is none like Thee. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who hearest the Teruah sound of His people Israel in compassion.

Take delight, O Lord our God, in Thy people Israel and in their prayer and restore the service to the sanctuary of Thy House and accept with love and favour the fire offerings of Israel and their prayer, and may the service of Thy people Israel be a perpetual delight. And may our eyes behold when Thou returnest to Zion in compassion. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who restores His majesty to Zion.

We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand and for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy kindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever.
And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant.

And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid, Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.

Bestow peace, good fortune, blessing, favour, grace and compassion upon us and upon all Israel Thy people. Bless us, our Father, all of us together through the light of Thy countenance, for through the light of Thy countenance hast Thou given us, O Lord our God, the Torah of life and gracious love, salvation and blessing, mercy, life and peace; and it is good in Thine eyes to bless Thy people Israel at every time and in every hour with Thy peace.

In the book of life, blessing, peace and a good livelihood, may we be remembered and inscribed before Thee, we and all Thy people the house of Israel for a good life and for peace. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who makes peace.

My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking falsehood. Towards those who curse me, let my soul be silent and let my soul be as dust in relation to everything. Open my heart to Thy Torah and let my soul pursue Thy commandments and as for all those that devise evil against me, speedily frustrate their counsel and upset their plan. Do this for the sake of Thy Name, do this for the sake of Thy right hand, do this for the sake of Thy holiness, do this for the sake of Thy Torah so that those who love Thee may be delivered. Save with Thy right hand and respond to me. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart find favour before Thee, O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer. May He who makes peace in His heights, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.

May it find favour before Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, that the sanctuary be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant our portion in Thy Torah. There we will serve Thee in awe as in the days of old and former years. And pleasant unto the Lord shall be the offering of Judah and Jerusalem as in the days of old and former years.

Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac and God of Jacob, great, mighty and awe-inspiring God; God the most high who performs acts of kindness and owns everything and remembers the good deeds of the fathers and will bring a redeemer for their children’s children for His Name’s sake in love.

Choosing from the counsel of wise and discerning men and from the teaching of those that understand knowledge, I open my mouth in prayer and supplication to entreat and implore the countenance of the King of kings and the Lord of lords.

From of old has this day been appointed for judgment, for testing every day’s work; the creatures approach the countenance of the Awe-inspiring One that on it He may grant them a verdict of deliverance. On this day was the first man created; he received a law but did not keep it; on this day did he find a defender (in God) who helped him in need and appointed it a day of judgment to be maintained for later generations. On this day the hewn out foundations, the hills and the rocks, were formed for the sake of the first of the forefathers; and they, as dwellers in the garden (Eden) were present at the work of creation that on this day they might plead for those created. This day’s month bears the name of the immortals (forefathers); it is a sign for those above and below to assemble for the books to be opened, for deeds to be related and for men to pass by Thee and render account. This day was appointed first for the order of Thy festivals, and for the flock to be led under the staff past Thee;
when Thy witnesses blow (remember) the Shofar today, remember, O Merciful One, the oath of Thy servants.
The sound of the Shofar rises with prayer, Almighty, to appease Thee with supplication;
return the flashing sword to its sheath, grasp the shield that we may shelter beneath it.

Remember us for life, O King, who takes delight in life and inscribe us in the book of life for Thine own sake, O living God, King, helper, saviour and shield. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, shield of Abraham.
